---
title: "Image editing results"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(grid)
```

```{r data}
# Change this path if the project folder moves.
project_dir <- "D:/Yelp/Image_Memorability"

a <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "02_editing/method_a/results_method_a/final_selection.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
b <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "02_editing/method_b/results_method_b/candidates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

sidorov_labels <- c(
  sidorov_vibrance = "Vibrance",
  sidorov_clarity_approx = "Clarity",
  sidorov_sharpening = "Sharpening",
  sidorov_temperature_5000k = "Warmer (5000 K)",
  sidorov_contrast = "Contrast",
  sidorov_vignetting = "Vignetting",
  sidorov_bg_blurring = "Background blur",
  sidorov_bg_blur_darkening = "Background blur + dark",
  sidorov_grayscaling = "Grayscale"
)

a_results <- a |>
  filter(method %in% c("A_guided", "A_study1", "A_empty")) |>
  mutate(label = method)
b_results <- b |>
  filter((method == "B1" & rank == 1) | method == "B2") |>
  mutate(label = if_else(method == "B1", "B1 search", "B2 Study 1 rule"))
sidorov_results <- b |>
  filter(candidate %in% names(sidorov_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = unname(sidorov_labels[candidate]))

positions <- tribble(
  ~label, ~y, ~group,
  "A_guided", 14, "Method A",
  "A_study1", 13, "Method A",
  "A_empty", 12, "Method A",
  "B1 search", 9.8, "Other",
  "B2 Study 1 rule", 8.8, "Other",
  "Vibrance", 6.6, "Other",
  "Clarity", 5.6, "Other",
  "Sharpening", 4.6, "Other",
  "Warmer (5000 K)", 3.6, "Other",
  "Contrast", 2.6, "Other",
  "Vignetting", 1.6, "Other",
  "Background blur", 0.6, "Other",
  "Background blur + dark", -0.4, "Other",
  "Grayscale", -1.4, "Other"
)

plot_data <- bind_rows(a_results, b_results, sidorov_results) |>
  group_by(label) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(d_vitmem)),
    vitmem = mean(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE),
    vitmem_se = sd(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    resmem = mean(d_resmem, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Two-sided paired comparison with the original, using per-photo changes.
    p_vitmem = if (sum(!is.na(d_vitmem)) >= 2 &&
                    sd(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      t.test(d_vitmem, mu = 0)$p.value else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ci_low = vitmem - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * vitmem_se,
    ci_high = vitmem + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * vitmem_se
  ) |>
  left_join(positions, by = "label") |>
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      is.na(p_vitmem) ~ "",
      p_vitmem < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_vitmem < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_vitmem < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    vitmem_text = sub("^-", "−", sprintf("%+.3f", vitmem))
  )
```

```{r appearance}
# Adjust these values to change the appearance.
text_size <- 5              # Text drawn inside the plot (ggplot units)
star_size <- 7              # Significance stars; increase or decrease as needed
title_size <- 15            # Title, legend and axis title (points)
axis_text_size <- 15
circle_size <- 4.5
diamond_size <- 4
diamond_stroke <- 0.9
ci_line_width <- 0.8
legend_icon_size <- 4       # Legend diamond size
legend_circle_size <- 4.5   # ViTMem legend circle size
legend_line_width <- 0.8
legend_key_width <- 0.9     # Centimetres; controls the available line length
diamond_key_position <- 0.85 # Move the diamond toward its label (0 to 1)
method_a_colour <- "#287BD7"
other_colour <- "#BDBDB4"
diamond_colour <- "#505050"
```

```{r legend-keys}
# Custom legend key: a horizontal interval with one central circle.
draw_key_vitmem <- function(data, params, size) {
  grobTree(
    segmentsGrob(
      x0 = unit(0.08, "npc"), x1 = unit(0.92, "npc"),
      y0 = unit(0.5, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.5, "npc"),
      gp = gpar(col = other_colour, lwd = legend_line_width * .pt)
    ),
    pointsGrob(
      x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), pch = 16,
      size = unit(legend_circle_size, "mm"),
      gp = gpar(col = other_colour)
    )
  )
}
# Keep the diamond close to its label without shortening the interval key.
draw_key_resmem <- function(data, params, size) {
  pointsGrob(
    x = unit(diamond_key_position, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), pch = 23,
    size = unit(legend_icon_size, "mm"),
    gp = gpar(col = diamond_colour, fill = "white", lwd = diamond_stroke)
  )
}
```

```{r plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=9, dpi=220}
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.05, 0.05, 0.10),
             colour = "#E7E7E3", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#C8C8C1", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Draw diamonds first, behind circles and intervals.
  geom_point(aes(x = resmem, shape = "ResMem change"),
             size = diamond_size, stroke = diamond_stroke,
             colour = diamond_colour, fill = "white",
             key_glyph = draw_key_resmem) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ci_low, xend = ci_high, yend = y, colour = group),
               linewidth = ci_line_width, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(x = vitmem, colour = group, shape = "ViTMem change"),
             size = circle_size, key_glyph = draw_key_vitmem) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -0.17, label = label), hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.135, label = vitmem_text), hjust = 1, size = text_size) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.137, y = y - 0.12, label = significance),
            hjust = 0, size = star_size) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.175, y = 14.9, label = "METHOD A",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.175, y = 10.7, label = "METHOD B",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.175, y = 7.5, label = "SIDOROV (2019)",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.135, y = 14.9, label = "ViTMem",
           hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Method A" = method_a_colour, "Other" = other_colour),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c("ViTMem change", "ResMem change"),
    values = c("ViTMem change" = 16, "ResMem change" = 23),
    labels = c("ViTMem change with 95% CI (compares the methods)",
               "ResMem change (the model that chose the edits)"),
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(
      colour = c(other_colour, diamond_colour), fill = c(other_colour, "white"),
      size = c(legend_icon_size, legend_icon_size), stroke = c(0.5, diamond_stroke)
    ))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10),
                     labels = c("−0.05", "0", "+0.05", "+0.10"),
                     limits = c(-0.18, 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 15.5), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_size = title_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = title_size),
    legend.key.width = unit(legend_key_width, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size, colour = "#555555", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = title_size, colour = "#555555", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = title_size * 0.8, colour = "#555555", hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
  )
p
```

```{r save, eval=FALSE}
# Run this chunk to export the plot after adjusting it.
ggsave(file.path(project_dir, "figures", "Figure_results_R.png"), p,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 220, bg = "white")
```
